segments.title: 第160章 偶遇應志誠
segments.content:
Chapter 160: An Unexpected Encounter with Ying Zhicheng

Regarding the specifics of their future collaboration, Li Luo and Yuan Wanqing only chatted about it briefly at the dinner table without going into too much depth.

After all, it was still too early to talk about these things.

Their first joint interview hadn't even started yet, and the effectiveness of this approach was still unknown.

Everything would depend on the subsequent public opinion and traffic before a correct judgment could be made.

Thus, after lunch, the group rested for a moment on the living room sofa before Yuan Wanqing suggested they head out.

After instructing the cooking auntie to clean up, Yuan Wanqing led them downstairs, where her exclusive nanny van was already waiting.

Qianzhou looked around curiously as he followed them into the vehicle.

This was the first time in his life he had ever ridden in a celebrity's nanny van.

The vehicle was an extended-length commercial van. After sliding the door open, he was greeted by a small space with seats facing each other, two rows on each side.

Yuan Wanqing habitually sat in the soft armchair on the right, near the driver. Yan Zhusheng then sat opposite her mother, patting the seat beside her for Li Luo to sit down.

When Qianzhou got in, he glanced at the empty seat next to Yuan Wanqing, felt too shy to sit there, and squeezed into the back row behind Li Luo and Yan Zhusheng.

After the assistant pulled the door shut, she sat in the front passenger seat. "Sister Yuan, are we heading to the company?"

"Yes, let's go." Yuan Wanqing nodded. "Have the people from Wen Yue Group arrived?"

"They're here already." The assistant nodded. "They're getting ready in the interview room. When we get there, we'll go to the makeup room first, and then we can start the official interview."

About to be interviewed, Li Luo felt a little nervous as he sat in the car.

After all, in both his past and present lives, he had never experienced being interviewed on the same stage as a celebrity.

Fortunately, Qianzhou had already sent him the questions Wen Yue Group prepared in advance, allowing him ample time to prepare.

They were all rather conventional questions.

At least they weren't as tricky as the ones Yuan Wanqing had asked at the dinner table.

With the Memory Palace at his disposal, Li Luo wasn't worried about any slip-ups.

Besides, the interview was being recorded. If he said something wrong, they could just re-record it.

Huayue Film and Television Company.

Ying Zhicheng was in his office reviewing documents. When it was almost one in the afternoon, his secretary knocked and came in, softly reminding him, "President Ying, your flight is at three this afternoon. It's time to get ready to leave."

"Alright." Ying Zhicheng nodded, finished reviewing the document in his hand, and twisted his neck in his chair. "Let's go."

Standing up and putting on his suit jacket, Ying Zhicheng walked ahead with his secretary following closely behind, briefly reporting on his upcoming schedule.

Ying Zhicheng listened as he walked, nodding from time to time, then asked, "How has Yuan Wanqing been recently? *Annual Rings* is quite popular lately, isn't it?"

"Ms. Yuan has a lot of engagements recently, her schedule is basically full." The secretary knew that Yuan Wanqing's comeback was personally supported by Ying Zhicheng, so she usually paid close attention to her news and now easily recounted her situation.

"I think there's an exclusive interview today, right here in the company."

"Oh?" Ying Zhicheng paused his steps and glanced at his watch. "I can spare a few minutes to go take a look, right?"

"Yes, there's enough time." The secretary nodded and quickly led Ying Zhicheng in another direction, toward Yuan Wanqing's interview room.

Following the secretary all the way to the makeup room next to the interview room, Ying Zhicheng knocked and then pushed the door open.

Inside the makeup room, Yuan Wanqing was sitting in front of a mirror, with a makeup artist and a hairstylist helping her with her look.

Her assistant and Yan Zhusheng were sitting on a nearby sofa, waiting.

As for Li Luo and Qianzhou, they were next door in the interview room, confirming the interview's content with the host sent by Wen Yue Group, so they weren't here.

The moment Ying Zhicheng walked in, Yuan Wanqing saw him in the mirror and said with a smile, "President Ying, what brings you here?"

"I have a flight this afternoon and just happened to have some spare time." Ying Zhicheng smiled, walked up behind Yuan Wanqing, and looked at her in the mirror. "You should be on solid ground now, right?"

"Just lucky." Yuan Wanqing shook her head and chuckled. "It was a fortunate mistake. Thanks to you recommending the song *Annual Rings* to the production team of *Immortal Fate of the Jade Pond*, otherwise, I wouldn't have such a great opportunity now."

"Opportunities are for those who are prepared." Ying Zhicheng patted her shoulder. "Only those with real talent can turn an opportunity into an advantage."

At this point, Ying Zhicheng paused, then asked, "I heard that at the music department's meeting a while ago, Zhai Senlei had something to say?"

"It was nothing major." Yuan Wanqing gave a faint smile. "After all, my new album didn't perform well, so it's normal for everyone to have some doubts."

"But I did come across two good songs. My passion was stirred, and I couldn't resist acquiring them first."

"They're from the same lyricist and composer as *Annual Rings*."

Ying Zhicheng nodded as he listened, but when he heard the last part, a look of doubt appeared on his face.

In his memory, wasn't the song *Annual Rings* written by Yuan Wanqing's daughter?

"Your daughter wrote new songs?"

"Huh?" Yuan Wanqing was also taken aback for a moment, then she understood and couldn't help but laugh.

She gestured toward the sofa. "Zhusheng, come over here."

"Oh." Yan Zhusheng obediently walked to Yuan Wanqing's side and looked at Ying Zhicheng. "Hello, Uncle."

"This is my daughter." Yuan Wanqing introduced her. "You should have met her a long time ago?"

"That was more than a decade ago." Ying Zhicheng looked at Yan Zhusheng and couldn't help but sigh. "I had a guess when I first came in, but I didn't expect it was really your daughter."

"Yes." Yuan Wanqing nodded, then said, "Zhusheng didn't write *Annual Rings*; it was one of her classmates."

"It just so happens that we have a small recording studio at home. When her classmate wrote the song, Zhusheng invited him over to record it."

"Then it was sent to Luo Fei, where we heard it."

"So that's how it was." Ying Zhicheng nodded in realization. "Then this classmate seems quite talented? He wrote new songs again?"

With the massive success of *Annual Rings*, this lyricist and composer could be said to have an impressive achievement to his name.

Although a song's popularity depends on many factors, it didn't stop Ying Zhicheng from showing him more respect.

"Yes," Yuan Wanqing said. "If President Ying is interested, you can take some time to listen to them."

"I trust your judgment," Ying Zhicheng said with a smile. "I'm not a professional in this area. If you think it's good, then it's good."

At that moment, the secretary beside him leaned in and whispered, "President Ying, it's about time."

"Oh, okay." Ying Zhicheng nodded and said, "Then I'll be going now, I have to catch a flight."

"Take care, President Ying," Yuan Wanqing said. "Next time you're free, I'll treat you to a meal."

"Alright, I'll remember that."

Ying Zhicheng waved and left the makeup room, preparing to go downstairs with his secretary.

But just two steps out the door, he bumped into Li Luo, who was coming out of the interview room.

Ying Zhicheng took half a step back and frowned. Just as he was about to say something, his eyes fell on Li Luo's face, and he froze.

"Li Luo?"

"Uncle Ying?"

The moment Li Luo saw Ying Zhicheng, he was completely stunned, never expecting to see him here.

But in the next second, he realized something, and his expression instantly changed.

"What are you doing here?" Ying Zhicheng asked strangely. "That's an interview room in there, isn't it?"

"This... um..." Li Luo pulled Qianzhou, who was behind him, signaling him not to speak carelessly, then managed to compose himself. "I'm classmates with Auntie Yuan's daughter. I was a guest at Classmate Yan's house today, and since Auntie Yuan had an interview here, I came along to see what it's like."

"Is that so?" Ying Zhicheng gave Li Luo a meaningful look but didn't press the matter right then and there, as he had a flight to catch.

So he nodded and said, "I have other business, so I have to go now. Have a good time here."

"Right, right..." Li Luo nodded hurriedly and watched Ying Zhicheng leave before finally letting out a sigh of relief.

"Who was that just now?" Qianzhou asked curiously.

"Uh... an elder of mine."

"Then why didn't you tell the truth?"

"If you wrote a novel like mine, would you tell?" Li Luo shot him a sideways glance.

Asked this, Qianzhou fell silent for a moment.

Thinking about it, it was indeed quite hard to talk about.

After all, Qianzhou was also an avid reader of Li Luo's novel and knew very well how much racy content the kid had written in it.

If an elder found out, it would be social suicide...

At this moment, Li Luo was already feeling numb.

He only knew that Ying Zhicheng worked somewhere in downtown Yuhang City, and he knew it was some kind of film and television company.

But he had no idea which one.

Who could have expected such a coincidence, that of all the luck, he would run into him.

Yuan Wanqing was actually a singer under the film and television company where Ying Zhicheng worked.

If he had known this earlier, Li Luo probably would have thought twice about agreeing to the interview.

After all, if Ying Zhicheng found out what he wrote and mentioned it to Ying Chanxi, he felt like he wouldn't be able to go on living.

But just as Li Luo thought he had gotten away with it, in the elevator on the other side, Ying Zhicheng was indeed lost in thought.

After exiting the elevator and arriving at the underground garage, Ying Zhicheng got into his car and instructed his secretary:

"After I get back from my business trip, I want you to look into something for me."

"Find out which of her daughter's classmates is the lyricist and composer for those songs of Yuan Wanqing's."

Hearing this instruction, the secretary was slightly stunned, but she didn't ask any further questions, simply nodding in response, "Yes, President Ying."

(End of Chapter)
